resources.string: Translate videos from any language into Arabic while keeping your content private.
We are glad you are here! TransVibe is your smart assistant, using advanced AI technology to process videos and translate them locally on your phone.
What can you do with TransVibe?
• 🔒 Full privacy: On-device processing and translation (without an internet connection after the required models are ready).
• 🎨 Complete control: Customize the appearance, size, and timing of subtitles to suit your needs.
• 💾 Flexible export: Save subtitles as SRT or WebVTT files with ease.
Choose your video now and let us take care of the rest.
TransVibe — Watch, understand, and translate with confidence.
